description:
Department: IT

Reporting To: Directory, IT & Security

Location: Remote, Canada or US

Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday-Friday, 9AM-5PM (ideally PST)

Vacancy Type:  This is an existing role we’re backfilling

Since 2010, Unbounce has empowered digital marketers to create high-converting campaigns that drive real results. It's an intuitive and powerful landing page builder with AI-powered conversion optimization features that help growing brands and agencies make smarter, data-driven decisions.

In 2024, Insightly joined the Unbounce family. Insightly provides a customizable and affordable CRM, along with marketing automation, and customer service tracking, and an integrations tool in a unified, go-to-market platform. Together, these applications have helped customers generate billions of leads, sales, and signups.

We're a results-focused, customer-obsessed team where technical expertise meets creative thinking. Here, innovative ideas are encouraged, growth is supported, and everyone has the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to our mission.

Please note our Talent Acquisition team will not reach out to you through channels like WhatsApp, Messenger or SMS services. All communication will be through official Unbounce email domains. Please double check the correct spelling in domains of any email communication you receive representing Unbounce.

About the Role

We are hiring a Security & Compliance Lead to protect Unbounce and keep our customers' trust. You will own our day-to-day security posture and incident response, keep us audit-ready, review the vendors we rely on, and answer customer security and privacy questions. You will be the escalation point and a go-to partner for Legal, Engineering, IT, Sales and Customer Success.

This is a high-ownership role on a small team. You will do more than monitor and respond: we want someone who finds weaknesses before they are reported, improves our controls and tooling, and builds the processes that make security and compliance repeatable. You will report to the Director of IT & Security.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own our security posture across our products: review and harden configurations and tooling (CrowdStrike Falcon, identity, SaaS and cloud), and drive remediation of vulnerabilities and findings with Engineering and IT.
  • Lead incident response and triage: security incidents, CrowdStrike Falcon alerts, reports from our bug bounty program, and external abuse and phishing reports, including takedowns and registrar escalations, against a 24-hour response target.
  • Review new products, integrations and features, including AI features, for security and privacy risk, and recommend controls before they ship.
  • Find and fix weaknesses proactively: connect the dots across reports, check that fixes hold, and automate manual work, including with AI tools.
  • Use AI tooling to do more with less, automating repetitive work such as triage, evidence collection and questionnaire responses so the team's capacity scales.
  • Own compliance (SOC 2) for both products: collect evidence, run control testing and remediate failing controls in Drata, and lead our response during each audit window.
  • Run vendor and sub-processor reviews: tier the vendor, check the evidence, rate the risk and keep our public sub-processor list current.
  • Answer customer security and privacy requests, including security questionnaires, DPAs, mutual NDAs (with Legal), HIPAA and BAA questions, and documentation on how we use AI.
  • Keep privacy compliance on track: the Data Privacy Framework certification, the annual privacy policy and sub-processor review, DPIAs and cookie consent.
  • Partner with Engineering and Legal on policy initiatives such as data deletion and change management.
  • Write and maintain the runbooks, templates and process docs that keep this work from depending on any one person.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call schedule for security incidents, which may include evenings and weekends.

A Little Bit About You

  • 5 or more years in security, ideally at a SaaS company, with hands-on experience in incident response, vulnerability management, and EDR or SaaS and cloud security.
  • The ability to improve controls, not just monitor them: you spot gaps, propose fixes and follow them through with Engineering and IT.
  • Hands-on experience with SOC 2 evidence collection and audit support. Bonus: using Drata or a similar GRC platform.
  • Experience reviewing vendors and managing third-party risk.
  • Working knowledge of privacy requirements, including GDPR, PIPEDA and CCPA.
  • Sound risk judgment: you know how to rate a vendor or a finding, and when to act and when to escalate.
  • Familiarity with (or similar tools) Jira, Confluence, GitHub and EDR tools such as CrowdStrike.
  • Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain security and privacy to non-technical people, including customers on calls.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tooling to do more with less, such as automating triage, evidence collection or questionnaire responses.

Nice to have

  • A certification such as CISSP, CCSP, CDPSE or similar.
  • Experience with healthcare data (HIPAA and BAAs) or AI governance, the EU AI Act.
  • Experience building runbooks or automation, including with AI tools, to cut manual work.

What success looks like

  • Security incidents and reports are triaged within target, including weekends, and nothing sits open unnoticed.
  • Our security posture measurably improves: vulnerabilities and findings are remediated on time and tooling gaps are closed.
  • Audits pass cleanly and SOC 2 controls stay healthy between audit windows.
  • Vendor reviews and customer questionnaires are turned around without holding up Sales or procurement.
  • Security and privacy knowledge lives in documented processes, not in one person's head.

Share Our Values

  • Customer First
  • Bias for Action
  • High Velocity Decision Making
  • Inclusion
  • Results Focused

Compensation 

Our compensation bands are designed to reflect how people grow in their roles. Each level includes three stages: Developing, Proficient and Expert, which represent increasing capability, independence and impact over time.

The salary range for this role is $96,000 - 105,000 CAD or $116,000 to $133,000 USD, which reflects the Proficient stage of our compensation band for this job level (P3).

Progression into higher stages and job levels may occur over time based on demonstrated performance, mastery of role expectations and overall impact.

For specialized or hard-to-fill roles, we may extend offers above the posted range if a candidate brings exceptional experience.

We Value Individuality!

At Unbounce, we want every employee to be excited to bring their full, authentic self to work. When you bring your unique experiences, background, knowledge, perspective, and self-expression while embracing the same from others we learn from each other. We innovate and co-create an environment where team members can do the best work of their careers. We're bolder and more brilliant together.

We're dedicated to ensuring each team member feels a sense of belonging, feels safe, cared for, respected and valued for who they are, and trusts that their unique voice is heard, embraced, and meaningfully contributes to decision-making. We're committed to equitable employee experience, opportunity, pay and support for every employee regardless of gender identity or expression, race, ethnicity, family or marital status, religion, socio-economic status, veteran status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, education, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you unique.

We have no tolerance for sexism, racism, xenophobia, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, ageism, or any other forms of hateful/harmful discrimination and we're taking action against unequal pay in our community through leading the #PayUpforProgress movement.

If you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please email us at careers@unbounce.com.

Our use of AI in hiring

We're committed to keeping hiring personal. Every application is reviewed by a real person on our team, and we don't use AI to screen or filter candidates out.

We do use AI to help with assessing candidates and summarizing interview feedback. These tools support our team in working more efficiently and reducing bias. All final hiring decisions are made by people who bring their judgment and experience to determine who joins our team.
